item.title: Trump demands passage of proof-of-citizenship voting bill, with ban on mail ballots
item.description: President Trump has demanded that Congress pass a strict proof-of-citizenship voting bill and end Americans' ability to vote by mail, threatening to veto any other legislation until it is passed.

item.title: Record highs possible Tuesday with a severe storm threat Tuesday night | Mar. 9, 2026
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — We are tracking record high potential Tuesday that will be followed up with more active weather late Tuesday into Wednesday. This will also include the threat for strong to severe storms. Monday night: Mostly cloudy with isolated showers possible. Lows in the low 60s. Tuesday: Much of tomorrow may end up dry […]

item.title: Gov. Braun chooses not to rule out tax suspension amid gas prices surge
item.description: Governor Mike Braun of Indiana has said he may consider suspending the state's gas sales tax if the war with Iran lasts longer than a few weeks, as gas prices have risen due to the war halting shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Trump predicts short-lived war with Iran, warns against oil disruption
item.description: Trump said the war with Iran could be short-lived, but warned that if Iran disrupts global oil supplies, they will be hit "twenty times harder" by the US.

item.title: Indiana Black Expo announces 2026 Music Heritage Festival outdoor concert lineup
item.description: The Indiana Black Expo has announced the artist lineup for the 2026 Music Heritage Festival Outdoor Concert, featuring Grammy-nominated soul artist KEM, singer-songwriter October London, King George, and Midnight Star.

item.title: Missing man with dementia found dead in Greenwood drainage ditch
item.description: The body of a 70-year-old man with dementia, who had been missing since Aug. 31, 2025, was found in a drainage ditch in Greenwood, Indiana. The cause and manner of death is pending an autopsy.

item.title: Indianapolis police search for missing teen, possibly in need of medical care
item.description: Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department are seeking the public's help in locating 18-year-old Traevion Pirtle, who was last seen on March 7th and may be in need of medical attention.

item.title: Speedway Town Council passes wastewater rate increase ordinance
item.description: The Speedway Town Council on March 9, 2026, unanimously passed an ordinance to increase monthly wastewater bills by an average of $11.14 per household to finance a state-mandated wastewater plant expansion expected to cost between $15 million and $18 million.

item.title: Greenwood Park Mall announces retail and dining additions
item.description: Greenwood Park Mall is adding a variety of retail and dining options, including GAP Factory, Offline by Aerie, Gaucho's Fire, Yamato, and Noriteo.

item.title: 16-year-old critically injured in shooting at Indianapolis apartments
item.description: A 16-year-old boy was in critical condition after being shot Monday night at an apartment complex on the city's north side. Police are looking for witnesses and video of the shooting and a disturbance that led to it.
